name: How much does it cost to remove an interior wall?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to remove an interior wall?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The price depends more on what the wall does and what it contains than on demolition alone. A structural opening may require engineering, a beam, posts, temporary support, utility rerouting, permits, inspections, drywall, flooring, trim, and painting; community estimates show that these additions can make costs vary widely.

Context: A non-load-bearing partition with no utilities is a different project from a long wall beneath a second floor or roof. A low quote may exclude finish work or engineering.

Key factors:
- Load-bearing status and opening width
- Beam type, posts, and foundation support
- Electrical, plumbing, HVAC, or gas relocation
- Flooring and finish matching

Practical guidance: Compare itemized bids, not demolition-only totals, and keep a contingency for concealed conditions. Elite Remodeling & Design can evaluate wall removal as part of a coordinated remodeling scope rather than pricing the opening in isolation.

The most useful estimate explains what is included, excluded, and triggered by site findings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary sharply. Structural support, utility relocation, permits, engineering, drywall, flooring, trim, and paint can matter more than demolition itself. Compare itemized scopes so a low removal price does not exclude restoration or required support.
